_comment: Every thing that decides whether an output is correct, with a positive_test proving it accepts a known-correct input and a negative_test proving it rejects a known-wrong one. Run by `pytest -q tests/test_instruments.py`. Subprocess invocations inside the tests use sys.executable (not bare python) so they run on hosts with only python3. A grader that cannot run must raise, never return a negative verdict (see test_accuracy_scorer_must_raise_on_empty).

instruments.name: data-loader
instruments.what_it_decides: Whether the training/evaluation data is the paper's own sklearn load_digits corpus (1797 8x8 digits, K=10 classes, pixels scaled to [0,1], class-stratified 70/30 split = 1257 train / 540 test at seed 0) rather than a synthetic or substitute corpus. A closed-book run that silently fell back to a synthetic corpus passed every gate and meant nothing; this instrument catches that by fingerprint (size, vocabulary, value range, dtype, and SHA-256 of the split arrays).

instruments.name: accuracy-scorer
instruments.what_it_decides: The test-set accuracy metric value (fraction of argmax(forward(Xte)) predictions matching the clean test labels), reported by run_experiment.evaluate and parsed from the 'FINAL accuracy=<float>' line into measured.json. This is the single number the claims' magnitudes are evaluated against.

instruments.name: final-line-parser
instruments.what_it_decides: Whether a run produced exactly one parseable 'FINAL accuracy=<float>' stdout line (the value run_all_arms.sh extracts into measured.json). A run with no such line, multiple such lines, or a malformed value is rejected as BLOCKED rather than fabricated into a number.
instruments.invokes: sys.executable (never bare python) to run run_experiment.py as a subprocess

instruments.name: degeneracy-equivalence
instruments.what_it_decides: Whether the lambda=0 path is bitwise identical (loss + all four parameter gradients) to an INDEPENDENTLY implemented plain cross-entropy routine, so the method at its no-op setting reproduces the baseline exactly (the paper's own verification gate). The check must REJECT a non-degenerate input (lambda=1, gate active), proving it is not a vacuous always-equal comparison.

instruments.name: structural-invariant-metrics
instruments.what_it_decides: The structural-invariant metric values run_experiment.py emits via --metrics-out (gate_w_min/max, target_min, target_sum_err, stopgrad_grad_err, param_count, degeneracy_*_err), which are the measured evidence the numbers gate adjudicates the paper's equation-invariants (Eqs. 1-4) against. These decide whether the method's structural claims hold: 0<w<lambda (Eq. 2), t in the simplex (Eq. 3), dL/dz=(p-t)/B with t constant (Eq. 3 stop-grad), one parameter set (paper §1), and lambda=0 == independent CE (paper §2). Computed on one batch with the trained params; independent of the 4000-step budget.
